S.FORM: mzyugi' sun na Tayal hya' ga, aring sa ini' uwah na' qu Gipun hga, nanak yaquw mnwah mgaga' squ ryax na magal ina' ga nanu' si kiy min'aring mtalah lga yasa qu mutuw mzyugi'. mnhhway qmara', hmkuy tari', mstawput(msttazil) sun maha zyugi' na Tayal balay hya' ga, nanu' qu sun maha mnhhway qmara' ka yasa siy s'rux ini' 'nrawmul iyal, ruw mnhawhway mkura' tay 'zil, ini' ga tay 'llaw mshzi'. hmkuy tari' hya' ga mnrawmul cikay hwinuk naha' ru hkuzyun cikay qu tari', mkura' cikay tay glaing rmuruw squ phkngyan naha'. mstawput /msttazil hiya' ga, wiy mstawput tay 'zil, ini' ga mstawput tay 'llaw. cyugal qu gluw na zyugi' qani.
